rows.en: (Lunch break, huh... What should I eat?)
What are you going to eat, Ranka?
Anything's fine, I guess?
Then let's eat something you like.
Hmm~ They don't sell what I like, so...
What is it you like again?
Pineapple cake, I guess.

Huh~
You don't see that in stores much, do you?

Big Bro makes it for me sometimes.
It's sooo good.

I see.
Now I'm kind of hungry...
Let's go to the school store!
(Ozma-san's pineapple cake, huh...)
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders. Ozma-san as in the Japanese.

rows.en: What are you going to eat, Ranka-chan?
(EX-Gear training's over!)

\p-kun,
good work today.

Oh, Ranka.
What are you doing here?

I saw everyone flying,
so I came to watch for a bit.

O-oh, I see...
That's kind of embarrassing.

You all fly around so smoothly, it's so cool.
I could never do that.
Alto and Michel are way better than me.
Then catch up to them and pass them!
Yeah, I'll keep working at it.
(...Okay, guess I'll go get changed.)

\p-chan,
good work today.

Oh, Ranka-chan.
What are you doing here?

O-oh, I see...
That's kind of embarrassing.

You all fly around so smoothly, it's so cool.
I could never do that.
Alto-kun and the others are way better, though.
rows.notes: Female. Alto-kun as in the Japanese.

rows.en: Yeah, I'll keep working at it.

(Another week finally over...
What should I do this weekend...?)

\p-kun,
good work this week.
Ranka, do you have any plans this weekend?
Hm? This weekend?

Um, I'm going shopping with Nana-chan...
and then maybe karaoke with Alto-kun
and the others.
...Sounds like you've got a packed weekend.

Yep! Well, I've kept Nana-chan waiting,
so I'll get going.
(...Maybe I'll go hang out with someone too.)

(Another week finally over...
What should I do this weekend...?)

\p-chan,
good work this week.

Ranka-chan, do you have any plans
this weekend?
...Sounds like you've got a packed weekend!
(...Maybe I'll go hang out with someone too.)
(P.E.'s next, huh... Guess I'll give it my all~)
Oh, Ranka.
I wonder what we're doing today?
I hope it's soccer.
I'd like it to be dancing.

Dancing in P.E., huh...
I can't see the teachers picking that.
I guess you're right...
Oh, we'd better get going.
(I bet it's running laps~)
(P.E.'s next, huh... I'll do my best.)
I hope it's volleyball...

Dancing in P.E....
I can't see our teachers picking that.
Yeah, that's true.
Oh, let's get going.

(...Since I came all the way into town,
maybe I'll look at some new clothes.)

Oh, Ranka.
Out shopping?

Yeah. I went to cook some rice, but we were
all out, so I rushed over to buy some.
You're such a scatterbrain, Ranka.
Huh? That's so meeean...
Ahaha, just kidding.

Well then, Big Bro's hungry,
so I'd better go.
(...Dinner, huh? Now I'm getting hungry too.)

Oh my, Ranka-chan.
Out shopping?
You're such a scatterbrain, Ranka-chan.
Ahaha, just kidding.
(...Dinner, huh? Now I'm getting hungry too.)
